methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: ODU and Google launch AI incubator to boost innovation in Hampton Roads - MSN
signals.signal_reading: ODU-Google AI incubator concentrates deep capability-building infrastructure in Hampton Roads metro hub, but signals potential for regional distribution if incubator outcomes reach beyond university walls into broader Tidewater economy.

signals.title: Healthcare providers say AI helps them focus on patients. But it also raises questions about privacy, security and the role of humans in medicine
signals.signal_reading: Healthcare providers in rural Southwest using AI for note-taking and admin tasks exemplifies shallow, platform-delivered adoption—broad usage but not deep capability development, keeping regions dependent on vendor tools rather than building indigenous AI expertise.

signals.title: Problem-solvers by nature: How Virginia Beach Fire put AI to work - FireRescue1
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Beach Fire Department internally developing AI applications demonstrates peer-driven, problem-solving approach that builds deep organizational capability through doing—a 'build it yourself' signal in a non-traditional sector that could catalyze broader municipal adoption patterns.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-backed community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia signals ground-up capability building in historically underserved region, potentially creating distributed AI fluency through local institutions if training goes beyond surface-level digital literacy.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: Richmond's young workforce feeling AI pressure without corresponding capability-building infrastructure suggests anxiety without empowerment—neither deep skills development nor broad access materializing, risking displacement rather than augmentation.
